facts.text: The hotel's address is Via Regina 40 in Cernobbio, Italy.
Four secluded villas sit in the heart of the hotel's centuries-old park.
facts.excerpt: Four secluded villas, nestled in the heart of the centuries-old park

facts.text: Services include private boat transfers, a boutique, a concierge and a helipad.
facts.excerpt: From private boat transfers to the boutique, from concierge to helipad

facts.text: The Cardinal Suite, on the first floor of the Cardinal Building, pays homage to Tolomeo Gallio, the visionary behind the villa.
facts.excerpt: Located on the first floor of the Cardinal Building, the suite pays homage to Tolomeo Gallio, the visionary behind the Villa.

facts.text: The Cardinal Suite has a generous terrace overlooking the lake.
facts.excerpt: A luxury heaven, with elegant interiors and a generous terrace overlooking the lake.

facts.text: Classic Rooms overlook the inner courtyard of the historic Cardinal's residence and can be interconnected for families.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the peaceful inner courtyard of the historic Cardinal’s residence, these rooms can be interconnected to accommodate families or guests seeking greater privacy

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms are in the Cardinal's Building or the Queen's Pavilion and have a front-facing view of Lake Como.
facts.excerpt: Located in the Cardinal’s Building or the Queen’s Pavilion, these rooms offer a privileged front-facing view of Lake Como

facts.text: Rooms come with a complimentary minibar.
facts.excerpt: Air conditioning, complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TV and a thoughtfully curated complimentary minibar

facts.text: The Executive Suite has two private balconies, one in the bedroom and one in the living room, opening onto the gardens.
facts.excerpt: Two private balconies—one in the bedroom, one in the living room—open onto the gardens and glimpses of the lake.

facts.text: Junior Suite Exclusive rooms combine yellow, red and blue with period furnishings.
facts.excerpt: vibrant hues of yellow, red and blue blend seamlessly with the understated elegance of period furnishings

facts.text: Deluxe Superior Rooms are on the upper floors of the Cardinal's Building with views of the lake.
facts.excerpt: Located on the upper floors of the Cardinal’s Building, they offer spectacular views of the lake

facts.text: Room service can be served in the guest's room or on the balcony.
facts.excerpt: transforming your room or balcony into a setting of intimacy and indulgence

facts.text: Junior Suite Exclusive rooms can be connected to an Executive Double Room for families or extended stays.
facts.excerpt: They may also be connected to an Executive Double Room, creating a bespoke and harmonious environment for families or extended stays.

facts.text: Presidential Suites are on the first floor of the Cardinal Building, overlooking the lake and gardens.
facts.excerpt: Situated on the first floor of the Cardinal Building, the two Presidential Suites exude light and splendour.
Pastel hues, understated elegance and views over the gardens make the Executive Rooms a perfect balance of comfort and distinction.

facts.text: The hotel describes its suites as dreamlike retreats.
facts.excerpt: the suites at Villa d’Este are dreamlike retreats
From 35 to 40 m²Starting from 1.500 € per night
